data.one_liner: Creates animated gradient backgrounds with customizable colors and alignments.
data.what_it_does: Animate a gradient between two color lists while optionally animating the gradient’s start and end alignments. It exposes a simple widget API that accepts primary and secondary color lists, alignment options, and animation controls.
use_when: You need a smooth animated gradient background for a widget
You want to quickly add animated gradients without writing custom animation code
You need support for AlignmentGeometry for RTL layouts
avoid_when: You require complex animation choreography beyond simple gradients
You need high-performance animations for many widgets simultaneously
You are building a large-scale app with many custom animations and prefer a single animation library
strengths: Simple API with only two required color lists
Supports both Alignment and AlignmentGeometry for RTL support
Allows custom duration, curve, repeat, and controller
weaknesses: Very small community and limited documentation
No example of advanced use cases or performance benchmarks
No support for other animation types (e.g., physics)
